title: Number of provinces (leetcode)
problemStatement: Solve “Number of provinces (leetcode)” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Problems on BFS/DFS).
intuition: "Number of provinces (leetcode)" needs the right graph algorithm. Clarify directed/undirected, weighted/unweighted, cycles. Unweighted shortest → BFS; non-negative weights → Dijkstra; negative → Bellman-Ford; 0-1 weights → 0-1 BFS.

approaches.title: Traversal / shortest-path skeleton
approaches.code:
from collections import defaultdict, deque

def solve(n, edges, src=0):
    # Skeleton for: Number of provinces (leetcode)
    g = defaultdict(list)
    for u, v in edges:  # adapt for weights
        g[u].append(v)
        g[v].append(u)
    dist = [-1] * n
    q = deque([src])
    dist[src] = 0
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        for v in g[u]:
            if dist[v] < 0:
                dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                q.append(v)
    return dist
limitations: Wrong algorithm for weights → WA; huge adj lists → MLE
